about: A pass reads the while's own nodes (chapter 4 § 4.3.3). The summary of the while refine is drafted again only when the previous pass's judge had something to say. Invalid: it reads pass.previous.node.plan, which is not in refine. Valid: pass.previous.node.judge.
sentences: Node 'draft_summary' reads pass.previous.node.plan, which is not in while 'refine'; a pass reads the while's own nodes.
